items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: So he said, 'Well, Mrs. Jones, trombones are pretty expensive

ctx.x: And so she called him. I think she knew him, and she called him and asked him how much does a trombone cost and how much is a lesson. So he said, 'Well, Mrs. Jones, trombones are pretty expensive and the lessons are pretty expensive, and I know you don't have the money to throw away like that. You don't know if he'll want to keep it up or not.' Said 'But that band he was talking about that he seen in the street parade, that's called the Booker T. Washington Community Center Band, and if you take him over there…
